observations: A large black multifunction printer/copier machine is shown in two photos.
Photo 0 shows the front view: control panel with screen and keypad, document feeder on top, two paper trays labeled '1' and '2', and a small label with '2500CT' visible on the front.
Photo 1 shows the right side view: side panel, ventilation slots, and a small label near the bottom right corner.
The machine appears dusty and has tangled cables on top.
No brand or model name is visible on any part of the machine in either photo.
The seller mentions it has been in storage for over a year and will need minor work.
